pre_survey.bear-red-8280: Data centers are the backbone of the modern digital economy and essential for technological progress, including AI and cloud services. While they require significant resources, the economic benefits, job creation, and infrastructure investments they bring to local communities outweigh the costs. We must prioritize innovation and global competitiveness.
pre_survey.goose-green-1254: I am deeply concerned about the strain large-scale data centers place on local infrastructure, specifically energy grids and water supplies. Prioritizing these facilities over environmental sustainability and the needs of residents is irresponsible, especially when the resource consumption is disproportionate to the local benefits.
